context: A business is reviewing its overall performance measures before setting its next strategic plan.
stem: Select the measure set that best reflects a Triple Bottom Line approach to assessing overall business performance.

options.label: A
options.text: Profit, market share and sales revenue only

options.label: B
options.text: Energy use, employee wellbeing and profit

options.label: C
options.text: Share price, dividend per share and operating profit

options.label: D
options.text: Production output, capacity utilisation and inventory turnover

option_rationale: Incorrect: these are economic or market measures and do not include social or environmental performance.
Correct: this combines environmental performance (energy use), social performance (employee wellbeing) and economic performance (profit).
Incorrect: these are financial measures and do not assess people or planet impacts.
Incorrect: these are operational measures and do not assess social and environmental outcomes.
